command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp
RANKS=${GPAW_RANKS:-16}
cat > slab.py <<'PYEOF'
import os, sys, time
from ase.build import fcc111
from gpaw import GPAW, PW
from gpaw.mpi import world

# Pt(111), 3x3 surface cell, 4 layers, 7 A vacuum -- the canonical slab size for adsorption work.
# ASE builds it from its own lattice constants, so the structure is pinned by the image, not staged.
slab = fcc111("Pt", size=(3, 3, 4), vacuum=7.0)
slab.calc = GPAW(mode=PW(400), xc="PBE", kpts=(4, 4, 1),
                 occupations={"name": "fermi-dirac", "width": 0.05},
                 txt="gpaw.txt")
t0 = time.time()
e = slab.get_potential_energy()
wall = time.time() - t0
ef = slab.calc.get_fermi_level()
if world.rank == 0:
    with open("result.tsv", "w") as f:
        f.write("atoms\t%d\n" % len(slab))
        f.write("ranks\t%d\n" % world.size)
        f.write("energy_eV\t%.6f\n" % e)
        f.write("fermi_eV\t%.6f\n" % ef)
        f.write("wall_s\t%.1f\n" % wall)
PYEOF
python3 -c 'import gpaw,ase;print("gpaw",gpaw.__version__,"ase",ase.__version__)'
echo "== Pt(111) 3x3x4 = 36 atoms, PW 400 eV, 4x4x1 k-points, PBE =="
mpiexec -n "$RANKS" --allow-run-as-root --oversubscribe python3 slab.py
g(){ awk -v k="$1" -F'\t' '$1==k{print $2}' result.tsv; }
NAT=$(g atoms); GOTR=$(g ranks); E=$(g energy_eV); EF=$(g fermi_eV); W=$(g wall_s)
# GPAW writes 'Converged after N iterations' only on a clean SCF exit -- a run that stops on
# the iteration limit has a plausible energy and no such line.
ITERS=$(awk '/Converged after/{print $3; exit}' gpaw.txt)
{
  echo "system            Pt(111) 3x3x4 slab, PW 400 eV, 4x4x1 k-points, PBE"
  echo "atoms             $NAT  want 36"
  echo "ranks_used        $GOTR  want $RANKS  (gpaw.mpi.world.size, not a serial fallback)"
  echo "scf_iterations    $ITERS  (present only on a converged exit)"
  echo "energy_eV         $E"
  echo "fermi_eV          $EF"
  echo "wall_s            $W  (SCF only)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$NAT" = '36'
test "$GOTR" = "$RANKS"
test -n "$ITERS"
# a Pt slab's Fermi level sits a few eV below vacuum; wildly off means a broken setup
awk -v f="$EF" 'BEGIN{exit !(f>-10 && f<10)}'
awk -v e="$E" 'BEGIN{exit !(e<0)}'
echo 'SMOKE CHECK PASSED'
